title: Callouts
format:

    quality: 2
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - 
          - "div.callout-header > button.callout-toggle-btn.collapsed[aria-expanded='false'][aria-controls='callout-1']"
          - "div.callout-header ~ div#callout-1.collapse:not(.show)"
          - "div.callout-header > button.callout-toggle-btn:not(.collapsed)[aria-expanded='true'][aria-controls='callout-2']"
          - "div.callout-header ~ div#callout-2.collapse.show"
